description: This file defines the ImageStyleInterface, an interface for image style entities in Drupal, including methods for managing image styles, generating URLs, effects, and dimensions.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the image style.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the image style.

methods.name: buildUri
methods.description: Returns the URI of the image when using this style.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL of the image derivative for an original image path or URI.

methods.name: getPathToken
methods.description: Generates a token to protect an image style derivative.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes cached media for this style.

methods.name: createDerivative
methods.description: Creates a new image derivative based on this image style.

methods.name: transformDimensions
methods.description: Determines the dimensions of this image style.

methods.name: getDerivativeExtension
methods.description: Determines the extension of the derivative without generating it.

methods.name: getEffects
methods.description: Returns the image effects for this style.

methods.name: addImageEffect
methods.description: Saves an image effect for this style.

methods.name: deleteImageEffect
methods.description: Deletes an image effect from this style.

methods.name: supportsUri
methods.description: Determines if this style can be applied to a given image.
